settings.title: Backed by an agency, not just a camera.

settings.editor: Every other production company on the Coast is a production company. That is the whole business.

Pepper is the content arm of Chilli, the Sunshine Coast marketing agency that has been growing local businesses since 1993. The practical difference is the first question we ask: not what you want the film to look like, but what it has to achieve — who it's aimed at, where it runs, and what it needs to shift.

That means strategists and marketers in the room at the planning stage, not just camera operators on the day. You get a corporate film built against an objective, and a team who can tell you when the thing you asked for isn't the thing that will work.

settings.editor: The questions we're asked most often before a corporate shoot. If yours isn't here, ask us — we'd rather answer it now than after the quote.

settings.title: How long does a corporate video take from brief to delivery?

settings.editor: [ accuracy read ] Most corporate projects run three to four weeks end to end — a week to plan and script, a shoot day, then two weeks in post. Tighter deadlines are usually possible; tell us the date and we'll tell you honestly whether it's on.

settings.title: What does a corporate video cost?

settings.editor: It depends on shoot days, crew and how much post the piece needs, so we quote per project rather than off a rate card. Every quote itemises what you're paying for, and we'll tell you if something on your wish list isn't worth the money.

settings.title: Do we need a script before we start?

settings.editor: No. Most clients come to us with a goal rather than a script, and shaping that into a story is part of the job — we're backed by Chilli, a marketing agency that's been doing exactly this since 1993.
We're based in Birtinya on the Sunshine Coast and shoot across South East Queensland and beyond. Our production vans are fitted out to run a full shoot anywhere, including sites with no power.

settings.title: Will our staff need to be on camera?

settings.editor: Only if you want them to be. Plenty of corporate work is voiceover, b-roll and on-screen text. When people are on camera we direct them properly — most say afterwards it was easier than they expected.

settings.title: Do you do photography and video on the same day?

settings.editor: Yes — it's usually the most cost-effective way to work, and it's how most of our corporate clients run their shoots. Headshots, team and culture stills and video all come out of one booking.
